why_this_matters: In characteristic 2 the Frobenius degree t is everything: the rank is Tr(B^t)+1, exponential in t. Pass 266 claims odd characteristic is t-BLIND -- the rank is just the characteristic-0 value for any t. But every odd prime power tested so far (q=9, q=25) has t=2, so a hidden t-structure could have been missed. q = 27 = 3^3 is the first odd prime power with t=3, and therefore the first genuine test of t-blindness in odd characteristic.
reading: W(3,27) was built over GF(27) = F_3[x]/(x^3-x+1) (20440 points and isotropic lines) and its F2 incidence rank computed directly. The result decides whether the Frobenius degree has any effect in odd characteristic. A match at t=3 -- after t=1 (six primes) and t=2 (q=9, q=25) -- makes the cross-characteristic mechanism of Pass 266 as well-attested as the char-2 side, and settles the asymmetry that Pass 262's refuted unification first exposed.
